content.user_title: Mine Paid Search Terms for Growth and Waste
content.value_statement: Paid search exports make it difficult to separate valuable queries from wasted spend. This skill produces keyword actions, negatives, n-gram waste rankings, and a maintenance diff.
actual_capabilities: Identifies converting queries that are not already represented as keywords.
Routes useful queries into add or move actions for matching intent groups.
Flags costly non-converting queries and recommends negative match types and levels.
Ranks one-word, two-word, and three-word patterns by measured wasted cost.
Produces an add, negate, and move maintenance diff for recurring reviews.
Scores supported ROAS spend-efficiency factors and labels each figure by evidence source.
limitations: Requires query, cost, and conversion columns before making keyword or negative recommendations.
Does not design campaign structure, allocate budgets, adjust bids, or compute the final RQS.
Relies on exported or pasted data and does not require direct advertising platform access.
Recommendations require human review before campaign changes or local report storage.

use_cases.title: Reduce Weekly Search Waste
use_cases.description: Review a fresh search-terms export and prepare negative keyword actions ranked by measured cost.

use_cases.title: Expand High-Intent Keywords
use_cases.description: Find converting queries that deserve dedicated keywords or placement in a matching intent group.

use_cases.title: Audit Spend Efficiency
use_cases.description: Create an n-gram waste ranking and scoped ROAS spend-efficiency notes for an account review.

prompt_templates.title: Find Basic Negative Keywords
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this search-terms export. List queries with meaningful cost and zero conversions, then recommend exact or phrase negatives.
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner review of wasted search spend

prompt_templates.title: Harvest Converting Queries
prompt_templates.prompt: Mine this export for queries with at least [threshold] conversions. Recommend new keywords or intent groups and identify existing duplicates.
prompt_templates.scenario: Keyword growth from proven customer searches

prompt_templates.title: Build a Waste Pattern Report
prompt_templates.prompt: Analyze non-converting queries above a [cost floor]. Rank one-word, two-word, and three-word patterns by measured cost and propose shared-list negatives.
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate analysis of recurring waste themes

prompt_templates.title: Run a Complete Maintenance Cycle
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the [profile] ROAS profile and this export. Produce add, negate, and move actions, an n-gram report, and spend-efficiency notes with evidence labels.

output_examples.input: A 30-day export with search query, cost, conversions, conversion value, and current keyword columns.
output: Add: Three converting queries qualify as new exact-match keywords.
Negate: Five zero-conversion queries exceed the stated cost floor.
Waste pattern: The top repeated two-word phrase accounts for the largest measured non-converting cost.
Handoff: Review the proposed actions before applying campaign changes.

output_examples.input: A prospecting campaign export with cost and conversion data, plus the existing negative keyword list.
output: Move: Two converting queries belong in a more specific intent group.
Shared negatives: Three recurring terms appear across multiple ad groups.
Spend efficiency: Waste share is measured, while benchmark comparisons remain unavailable.

output_examples.input: A search-terms report that includes clicks and cost but omits conversions.
output_examples.output: Analysis stopped because the conversion column is missing. Provide conversion data before harvesting keywords or recommending negatives.

best_practices: Provide a fresh export with query, cost, conversions, and conversion value when available.
Set explicit conversion and cost thresholds before evaluating queries.
Review match type, scope, and intent before applying any negative keyword.
anti_patterns: Do not negate terms from click volume alone when conversion data is missing.
Do not treat estimated benchmarks as measured account performance.
Do not use this workflow to redesign campaigns or change budgets and bids.

faq.question: What columns are required?
faq.answer: The workflow requires query, cost, and conversions. Conversion value is also needed for ROAS-based scoring.

faq.question: Does this skill connect directly to an advertising platform?
faq.answer: No direct connection is required. You can provide a manual export or paste the relevant report data.

faq.question: Can it apply negative keywords automatically?
faq.answer: No. It recommends match types and placement, but a user should review and apply campaign changes.

faq.question: How does it find wasted spend?
faq.answer: It identifies non-converting queries above a stated cost floor and aggregates recurring one-word, two-word, and three-word patterns.

faq.question: Can it redesign my campaign structure?
faq.answer: No. It can identify structure gaps and hand them to a campaign architecture workflow.

faq.question: How often should I run it?
faq.answer: Run it weekly or monthly with a fresh export. Choose a cadence that matches search volume and campaign change frequency.
